title: Shurmer and Avi Loeb's alien bet with the Long Now Foundation

tellings.quote: Um, well, so Obby and I have a bet, you know, $1,000 bet.

plain: The professional skeptic Michael Shermer says he and the Harvard-style researcher Avi Loeb, a scientist who argues for looking for alien technology, have made a $1,000 bet about aliens, set through a group called the Long Now Foundation and tied to the year 2030. Shermer tells this himself, as one of the two people who made the bet, though he gives few details of the terms beyond the stakes.
